title: Kenworth T909 FUPS Custom Bullbar #46
description: Kenworth T909 high tensile polished aluminium FUPS Bullbar. Texas style channel. Standard 76mm diameter pipe but optional 88mm or 100mm pipe can be ordered. Heavy duty tow pin and high tensile aluminium backing plate. One piece pipes through drilled heavy duty posts. Bull bar can be custom built to your specification.
